compress-videos-iphone.question: Can Fast Cleaner help make an iPhone video smaller?
compress-videos-iphone.answer: Fast Cleaner offers video compression on iPhone. Export a copy, check fine detail and playback, then decide what to keep. Smaller files can involve a quality tradeoff; neither a fixed saving nor a visually identical result is guaranteed.

compress-videos-iphone.app: Use Fast Cleaner to make a candidate smaller copy, then compare duration, speech, motion, text and dark areas against your retained original. Android users can review large videos in the Android app; do not assume every iPhone export option is available on Android.

delete-duplicate-photos-iphone.question: Should I use Apple Photos or Fast Cleaner for duplicate photos?
delete-duplicate-photos-iphone.answer: Start with Apple Photos for the duplicates it identifies. Fast Cleaner is another option when you want to review similar photos, screenshots and large videos in a cleanup workflow. Inspect the actual files before confirming removal; similar pictures can capture different details.

iphone-storage-full.answer: Fast Cleaner can help you review unwanted local media when photos and videos are taking up space. It cannot increase the phone’s built-in capacity or repair every cause of a storage warning. Identify the large category before choosing a cleanup action.

iphone-storage-full.app: If the issue is unwanted camera-library media, use Fast Cleaner to inspect likely cleanup candidates. If the issue is a large app database or a cloud backup, work in the appropriate app or cloud settings instead.

duplicate-photos-not-showing-iphone.answer: Fast Cleaner provides a separate review workflow for duplicate and similar photos. A missing Apple Duplicates collection can still reflect indexing or a lack of identified matches, so it is worth checking Apple’s prerequisites before choosing another tool.

cleanup-before-buying-new-phone.question: Can Fast Cleaner help me keep my current phone longer?
cleanup-before-buying-new-phone.answer: Fast Cleaner may help when unwanted photos and videos are the immediate storage problem. It cannot repair a battery, extend software support or add camera hardware. Clean up, repeat the blocked task, and base an upgrade decision on what remains unsolved.

rising-phone-cloud-storage-costs.question: Can Fast Cleaner reduce my cloud storage bill?
rising-phone-cloud-storage-costs.answer: Fast Cleaner can help review unwanted media, but using a cleaner does not automatically lower a cloud bill. A plan change only makes sense after checking total cloud usage, sync behavior and the capacity required for the files and backups you keep.

rising-phone-cloud-storage-costs.app: Treat Fast Cleaner as a media-review tool in the comparison, not a substitute for a backup service. Only describe a bill reduction after you have actually changed a plan and verified the new charge.

Consider repair, official update support and essential hardware requirements separately when deciding whether to replace the device.

Fast Cleaner’s policy describes local media analysis, but local processing does not mean the app cannot read the photos you permit. Review access before scanning a sensitive library.
